descriptionHtml:
DeepCool AG400 PLUS Air Cooler

​The DeepCool AG400 PLUS is a high-performance single-tower CPU cooler that evolves from the classic Gamma Archer/AK series. It features a dual-fan configuration in a push-pull setup for enhanced thermal dissipation.

​General Specifications

  • ​Cooler Type: Single Tower, Dual Fan
  • ​TDP (Thermal Design Power): Up to 220W
  • ​Socket Compatibility:
    • ​Intel: LGA 1851 / 1700 / 1200 / 1151 / 1150 / 1155
    • ​AMD: AM5 / AM4

​Heatsink & Fan Details

  • ​Heat Pipes: 4x 6mm high-performance copper heat pipes.
  • ​Base Technology: Bidirectional Heat Pipe Direct Touch (DT) for efficient heat transfer.
  • ​Fin Design: Matrix Fins (Checkered pattern) to increase surface area and airflow efficiency.
  • ​Fan Model: 2x 120mm PWM Fans (Push-Pull configuration).
  • ​Fan Speed: 500 ~ 2000 RPM (±10%).
  • ​Airflow: Max 75.89 CFM.
  • ​Static Pressure: Max 2.53 mmAq.
  • ​Noise Level: ≤ 31.6 dB(A) (at full load with both fans).

​Physical Dimensions

  • ​Total Height: 150 mm (Excellent compatibility with smaller/mid-tower cases).
  • ​Total Width: 125 mm.
  • ​Total Depth: 107 mm (Including both fans).
  • ​Weight: ~748g.

​Key Highlights

  • ​Push-Pull Efficiency: The secondary fan significantly improves the exhaust of hot air from the heatsink compared to the standard AG400.
  • ​RAM Clearance: Designed with an offset heat pipe layout to ensure 100% RAM compatibility without interfering with high-profile memory sticks.
  • ​Easy Installation: Features a simple, sturdy mounting bracket system that is notorious for being user-friendly.
  • ​Stealth Design: Features a clean, industrial look with a top cover that conceals the heat pipe ends.
